mapper.sql: CAST(e.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(e.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId,COALESCE(m.username,'') AS username,e.gift_name AS giftName, e.points,COALESCE(e.source,'EXCHANGE') AS source,e.status,e.tracking_no AS trackingNo,DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, e.issued_by_name AS issuedByName,DATE_FORMAT(e.issued_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS issuedAt,e.issue_remark AS issueRemark
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_thread SET deleted=#{deleted} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE forum_thread SET pinned=#{pinned} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE forum_thread SET solved=#{solved} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(c.thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,CAST(c.author_account_id AS CHAR) AS authorAccountId,c.author_name AS authorName, c.content,CAST(c.parent_comment_id AS CHAR) AS parentCommentId,c.likes_count AS likes,c.deleted,DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,t.title AS threadTitle FROM forum_comment c LEFT JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=c.thread_id WHERE 1=1 AND c.thread_id=#{threadId} AND (c.content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.author_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND c.deleted=#{deleted} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,deleted FROM forum_comment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_comment SET deleted=#{deleted} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted!=#{deleted}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,status FROM forum_exchange WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_exchange SET status='SHIPPING',tracking_no=#{trackingNo},issue_remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_ISSUE'

UPDATE forum_exchange SET status='ISSUED',issued_by=#{issuedBy},issued_by_name=#{issuedByName}, issued_at=NOW(),issue_remark=CASE WHEN #{remark}='' THEN issue_remark ELSE #{remark} END WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SHIPPING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM forum_exchange e LEFT JOIN forum_member m ON m.account_id=e.account_id WHERE e.id=#{id}
